title: High Expressive Ratio

location.series: COLLINS / Figma / Nothing Great Is Made Alone case study

slide_intent: Demonstrate a shared visual vocabulary across subjects because consistent cues help viewers connect different stories.
strategic_value: Contributor labels and editing marks can keep Figma identifiable across art, science, architecture and literature.
demonstration: Two illustrated posters and a street-poster photograph share outlined drawings, colored contributor labels and editing cues; orange handwriting names the subject areas.
practical_value: Compare whether a small set of recognizable ingredients can support several subjects.

content_islands.name: Art and science
content_islands.spec: Place the Mona Lisa and relativity illustrations side by side at left.

content_islands.name: Street series
content_islands.spec: Place the wider campaign photograph at right, preserving its varied poster messages.

content_islands.name: Subject annotations
content_islands.spec: Keep orange Art, Science, Architecture and Literature notes beside their examples.

reference_purposes.Intent: The adjacent High Expressive Ratio description explains generating expressive variety from few elements.
reference_purposes.Application: The comparison applies the same labels, cursors and drawing style to several campaign subjects.
